stem.en: Someone opens a bottle of perfume in one corner of a closed room. No fan is on. What do you think happens next?

text.en: The smell stays in that corner, because nothing pushes it.

feedback.en: Good guess, but the particles are never still. They keep moving even when no fan pushes them.

text.en: The smell slowly spreads until the whole room smells of it.
The smell rises to the ceiling and stays there.

feedback.en: The particles move in every direction, not only upwards. So the smell reaches the floor too.

explanation.en: The perfume particles keep moving and bumping into air particles. Slowly they spread from where there are many of them to where there are few. This spreading is called **diffusion**.

hints.en: Are the perfume particles still, or moving?
Moving particles bump into air particles and change direction many times.
